points.title: Sleep
points.titleSub: (Going to bed at the same time every night)

body.text: Your phone charges in the kitchen. You are in bed by eleven. You wake up without an alarm inside two weeks.
It exists to check that the batch endpoint sends ten decks to TikTok in one call. Delete it when that is confirmed.
